entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: A stall in December hike pricing after the overnight 6.6bp rise, or a bounce in euro off 1.0975 that shows the extreme is being sold rather than extended.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: Euro lifts off the one-year extreme once December hike pricing stops being marked higher and dollar longs have no fresh information to buy.

entry_rationale: Buy 5 million euro. This fades the crowded long-dollar-versus-euro at 1.0975, a one-year z-score of -2.56, after December hike pricing of about 44bp rose another 6.6bp overnight. There is no fresh positioning print, so the ownership read is the price location and the already-priced path, not a net-spec figure. Paying or receiving March SOFR would join a strip the price already owns.
